strict_v01.selection: 15 candidates, volume on/off, cost 1/1.5/2; no parameter optimization

simple_v02.purpose: One exploratory simplification after observing v01; not a fresh holdout
simple_v02.sweep_fvg: Keep fixed presession range sweep, replace FVG/HTF filter with close beyond the three bars preceding the sweep, within four bars. Same stop, target and cost gates.
simple_v02.ema_rsi: Keep 9/21/50 stack, H1 agreement, touch, bar-break and RSI band; remove requirement that RSI crosses 50 on exactly the confirmation bar.
simple_v02.vwap_revert: Use efficiency ratio <=.35 for range state, RSI(2) recovery from 10/90 and close-direction confirmation; preserve tick-weighted deviation, target-room and stop filters.
simple_v02.dtfx_pullback: Freeze prior confirmed high-low range instead of extending to breakout extreme; range >=1 ATR; remove impulse-body filter; remember zone touch for eight bars, confirm with body and prior close rather than prior high/low.
simple_v02.ema_trend: Keep 20/50/200 stack, H1 agreement and RSI band; use EMA20 close recovery and prior-close improvement instead of prior-bar break plus efficiency filter.
simple_v02.fixed_before_v02_pnl: No changing periods, sessions, targets, costs or risk rules after viewing v02 returns. No additional search planned.
simple_v02.multiplicity: 60 rule variants across two revisions, three instruments, five families, volume on/off; cost scenarios are robustness checks, not independent discoveries. Account for previous project trials too.
